subject: dispatch_once

observation.summary: _dispatch_once is defined in __TEXT,__text of the arm64e slice at offset 0x00006548; the public C name dispatch_once resolves via underscore rename.

claim: dispatch_once is exported by libdispatch (macOS 27 / arm64e) as _dispatch_once at offset 0x6548. It is the canonical Apple recursive-once primitive and is NOT interchangeable with C11 <threads.h> call_once, which has different memory-ordering guarantees and a different ABI; any tools/tooling that substitute call_once for dispatch_once are observing a different behavior than Apple's pinned-once primitive.
